subject: Expansion request: onboarding additional projects and API keys for LumenEdge
messages:
From: Samantha King <sam.king@lumenedge.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion: onboarding 3 new projects + API keys

Hi Mateo / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — LumenEdge is ready to move forward with expanding Redwood across several internal teams. High level: we want to bring three additional projects online (billing front-end, claims-automation, and customer chat). That means: new API keys per project, a staged rollout over the next 6–8 weeks, and a short-term bump in committed capacity while we validate stability.

Quick details:
- Pilot scope: billing front-end (low concurrency, high token usage)
- Phase 2: claims-automation + chat (chat will need streaming and function-calling enabled)
- Expected monthly token volume (combined): ~450M tokens; current committed tier covers ~220M
- Need term change / amendment for the quarter to reflect higher commit and revised overage rates

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (LumenEdge-MAP-v2.xlsx) and a network diagram showing where requests will originate. Two asks from your side to get started:
1) A recommended rollout schedule and checklist for API key provisioning per project (we want role-based key separation).
2) A rough price delta for moving from our current commit to the proposed interim commit (estimate for 3 months) — we can formalize with your commercial team later.

Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff this week? I'm available Thu 9–11am PT or Fri 1–4pm PT.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting the pilot rolling.

Best,
Samantha King
Head of Integrations, LumenEdge
Samantha.King@lumenedge.com
ops+onboard@lumenedge.com

Attachments: LumenEdge-MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), network-diagram.png (png)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha King <sam.king@lumenedge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding 3 new projects + API keys

Thanks Samantha — great to hear LumenEdge is ready to scale.

High-level response and proposed next steps:
- We can definitely stage the rollout: Pilot → Phase 2a → Phase 2b. Pilot (billing front-end) is the right first step.
- On API keys: we typically provision a vault-backed key per project and recommend a service account per environment (dev/stage/prod). We'll provide a template keying matrix and an automated provisioning script.
- Capacity/terms: I can run a short model to estimate an interim commit for the 3-month window and propose an amendment. For a ballpark: moving from 220M → 500M monthly commit will change the monthly invoice roughly in the 2–2.5x range depending on model mix and caching. I'll confirm with Ben for precise numbers.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Internal: Ben — can you run a quick pricing calc with token breakdowns (avg tokens per call, model mix) and propose a 3-month interim commit and overage rate?
2) Internal: Monica — please draft the API key matrix and the rollout checklist for Mateo to review.
3) External: Samantha — if you can confirm which project you want for the pilot (billing front-end confirmed?), we can lock the pilot window next week.

I can do Thu 10am PT for the kickoff (tight window) — otherwise Fri 2pm PT works.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Cc: ops+onboard@lumenedge.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding 3 new projects + API keys

Mateo — thanks for the quick reply. Pilot is confirmed for billing front-end (team name: BE-Billing). A couple clarifications:
- Pilot traffic: expected 2M tokens/day during business hours, mostly generation with some embedding calls for lookup.
- Models: we'll use a small LLM for classification and a mid-sized for generation (we can share model IDs in the kickoff).
- Timeline: aim to have keys and sandbox access by next Tue; production rollouts for the other two projects targeted 6–8 weeks thereafter.

We can do Thu 10am PT for the kickoff. I'll send a calendar invite.

Samantha

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Samantha — great to hear LumenEdge is ready to scale...

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion: onboarding 3 new projects + API keys — internal kickoff prep

Folks — forwarding the thread and attaching the draft MAP. Quick internal plan before the Thu kickoff:

Summary of asks from LumenEdge:
- Sandbox keys for BE-Billing by next Tue
- Role-separated key matrix for 3 projects
- Interim 3-month committed uplift to ~500M tokens/month

Internal action items (owners / due):
- Ben: pricing calc and proposed amendment language (due Wed EOD). Include both per-token commit pricing and a blended overage rate for streaming+non-streaming usage.
- Mateo: provisioning script + keying template (review by Wed noon) and run a security checklist for sandbox access (IP allowlist, VPC egress notes).
- Laura: coordinate legal on a short amendment noting temporary commit increase and rollback terms (will need a simple SOW attachment).
- Monica: I will package the MAP and prepare a Hornet (internal) playbook for the kickoff; also confirm the Drive folder and calendar invite.

Notes:
- Attachments: LumenEdge-MAP-v2.xlsx (uploaded to the Drive link in the thread).
- We should propose a 1-week pilot validation window (metrics: error rate <0.5%, median p99 latency target met, and cost per 1k tokens within 15% of projection).

If no objections, I'll push the draft amendment to HubSpot and have it pre-populated so Legal can do a light review.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
